tests: an adapter reporting completed without invoking the hook is refused with the scrub root intact, and the same adapter invoking the hook succeeds
a turn-end record that is present but does not parse is refused just as an absent one is

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The completion precondition (src/spawn.ts:299) reads the file the GENERATED turn-end hook writes, and the hook is run as a child process with spawnSync (src/spawn.ts:232), so red-witness rule (f) binds this witness: SPAWN_GREP matches src/spawn.ts, which every member here mutates. The capture at witness/captures/spawn-turn-end-hook-record.txt:1 is real output of that hook, taken 2026-09-16 on node v26.6.0 against a hook rendered by src/hooks.ts renderTurnEndHook(): an integer argument exits 0 and writes a two-key JSON record, and a non-integer argument exits 64, writes NOTHING and prints "tiphys turn-end hook: expected one integer exit-code argument". The bad-argument arm is the shipped route to the absent record this witness is about, so the named test reproduces the recorded contract against a live hook before exercising the refusal, and the refusal is anchored on that program's real behaviour rather than on a hand-written string (CLAUDE.md warning 10). Added in the M4-P2 fix round after the gate refused this spec under rule (f); the round's mistake was deducing the gate's verdict from a hand-listed subset of its rules instead of running it.
